message:
docs(service-worker): render the SwPush and SwRegistrationOptions examples

The api-gen extractor only interpolates `{@example <path> region='<name>'}`,
so the three `<code-example>` tags on `SwPush` and the `header` on the
`SwRegistrationOptions` example are never substituted. Both ship to the API
pages as literal markup, and the snippets they point at are missing.

`push.ts` was the last file under `packages/*/src` still using the
`<code-example>` form.
